missing_information: Whether incoming data should replace an existing contact with the same email.
rationale: Both retaining and overwriting existing contacts are supported; no local policy decides.
expected_evidence: Ask the product owner what should happen for duplicate emails.
user_reply: Preserve the existing contact when an email already exists, even if the incoming name differs. Add only new emails.
limitations: Review full agent traces; functional success alone does not establish the resolution strategy.
